title: Aubergine Kebab
description: A classic Indian-inspired dish, this aubergine kebab is marinated in spices and grilled to perfection. Serve with your favorite sides for a flavorful meal.
instructions: Cut the aubergine into 1-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Add the kebab spice mix, lemon juice, and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the marinated aubergine to the pan and cook for 5-6 minutes per side.
Once the aubergine is tender, remove from heat and let it rest for 2 minutes.
